name: UWBench
description: UWBench is a comprehensive vision-language benchmark designed for underwater understanding. It includes 15,003 high-resolution underwater images with human-verified annotations, object referring expressions, and question-answer pairs to evaluate models on image captioning, visual grounding, and visual question answering in challenging underwater environments.
reputation: A newly introduced underwater vision-language benchmark that is useful for niche research, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on underwater vision-language understanding with diverse aquatic environments and challenging visual conditions.
